evidence_search.notes: Recovered the public Gemini share identifier, directly reviewed a 21-page archival print capture of the shared interaction, added direct affected-party interview reporting and recovered a more specific provider containment statement. No public engineering postmortem establishing root cause or occurrence-specific safeguard state was located.

candidate_classes_tested.recognition_and_exclusion_note: External reviewer uncertainty about hidden safety-control state does not establish that the deployed system itself failed to determine control availability.
Provider policy breach and harmful output do not establish an available/applicable control, a defined trigger and non-activation before output.
No safeguard is evidenced as becoming operative without a valid trigger; this is the inverse of the observed harmful generation.
No protected vulnerability or mental-health signal from the user is evidenced as being repurposed for influence.
The wording is coercive, but no system objective and instrumental tactic to obtain a behavioural state transition are evidenced.
The user was not presenting an unstable consequential decision frame or seeking high-stakes guidance; the death-directed output was an unsolicited non sequitur.
No independently established governing source constraint or transformation lineage supports a constraint-rendering diagnosis.
Environmental insult language does not create a biospheric-governance mechanism absent an applicable ecological constraint and objective-driven decision pathway.
